name: Glittering Pole
body:
School: evocation [force]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Prop: Pole

EFFECT

Range: Touch

Target: Creature touched

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Fortitude half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause motes of light to dance off your pole, striking your foe and making movement difficult. The target takes 2d6 points of force damage +1 point per caster level . If the target fails a Reflex save, it is slowed (as the slow spell) until the end of your next turn. If you are wielding a pole, the target is immobilized (as the hold person spell) instead of slowed if it fails its Reflex save.
